title: T4 Call cost records in the session document, idempotent keyed writes, turn index; retire delta counters and gateway ledger writes
description: Pivot ticket. Depends on T1, T2, T3. Files: new conversation/src/ledger/call-cost.ts (ModelCallCost, chatticus.cost defineDoc like conversation/src/pi/channel-log.ts), conversation/src/turn/finalize.ts (measureTurnUsage, recordTurnSpend), conversation/src/turn/executor.ts (calls at conclude, fail, yield, park), conversation/src/gateway/model-gateway.ts (stop writing the ledger), conversation/src/store/turn-store.ts and conversation/src/domain/turns.ts (remove ledger_input_recorded and ledger_output_recorded), computer/host/src/owner-deps.ts (empty VendorPriceBook), turn index pk {tenant}#cost#{yyyy-mm} sk turn#{turnId} with bot_id, channel_id, prompt_author_id, prompt_message_seq, message_seq, owner_kind. Fixes F1, F3, F5(e). Acceptance: plan scenarios 1 to 5 and 20 pass; T1 scenario passes; vitest and cucumber-js green; no dual reader.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Started T4. Design: one writer deriveCostRecordsFromEntries (conversation/src/ledger/call-cost.ts) writes chatticus.cost keyed records entry-<entryId> (fork initial, filter on conversationId) at conclude, fail, yield, park and when a resumed owner starts; the ledger row and the monthly turn index item are projected from those records in one transaction (turn-cost.ts); delta counters removed. Spike decision applied: no afterResponse hook.

comments.text: PR 538 open (not merged). One writer deriveCostRecordsFromEntries; records at conclude/fail/yield/park/resume; ledger row and monthly turn index projected from the same record sum; delta counters and measureTurnUsage removed; owner role policy gained the cost partition. 3 new features (11 scenarios); mutation checks on entry key, conversationId filter, fork mode, yield and park each fail a scenario. right_now_summary: PR 538 implements idempotent call-cost records and monthly turn indexes; tests pass, but it is not merged.
